CURRENT QUESTION:
centre wise attendance percentage for 2023 and 2024 side by side - average of the monthly rates
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH attendance_combined AS (
  SELECT
    "Centre" AS centre_name,
    "Month" AS month,
    "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment,
    "Avg Daily Present" AS average_attendance,
    2023 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    "centre_name",
    "month",
    "enrolment",
    "average_attendance",
    2024 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
monthly_rates AS (
  SELECT
    centre_name,
    year,
    (CAST("average_attendance" AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF("enrolment", 0) * 100) AS attendance_rate
  FROM attendance_combined
)
SELECT
  centre_name,
  AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN attendance_rate END) AS "2023_attendance_percentage",
  AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN attendance_rate END) AS "2024_attendance_percentage"
FROM monthly_rates
GROUP BY centre_name;
```
